data.overview: A small-time offender pretends to be mentally ill to avoid prison and is sent to a psychiatric ward instead. There he wins the trust of its patients and challenges the iron rule of the nurse who controls their lives.
data.tagline: Who gets to decide what freedom looks like?
data.title: One Flew Beyond the Ward
